fields.reference: Enter the date the case was filed (MM/DD/YYYY, e.g., 07/23/1998).

fields.label: PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL
fields.reference: Enter the name and contact information of the plaintiff's counsel.

fields.label: JUDGE
fields.reference: Enter the name of the judge assigned to the case.

fields.label: TRIAL DATE
fields.reference: Enter the scheduled trial date (MM/DD/YYYY, e.g., 11/28/2025).
